pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Relay Pylon$(): 16-block links$(li)$(bold)Large Relay Pylon$(): 32-block links$(br2)Blocks between pylons don't matter. Sealed walls do.

pages.title: Feedthrough
pages.text: A full block that carries links through a sealed wall without breaking the seal. Link to it from both sides.$(br2)Breaking it removes its links.

pages.text: Relay outside, feedthrough in the wall, relay inside.
